editorial.description_en: A roof tile made from local clay, seen dry. Redder than unglazed ware and a step down in light.
editorial.description_ja: 土を焼いた瓦のような、赤みの強い色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.630, C 0.086, h 44.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 土 (tsuchi, earth) + 瓦 (kawara, roof tile), rendaku to -gawara. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Earth Tile" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 土瓦. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — su-yaki at ΔE00 7.1, sabi-suna at ΔE00 7.5, aka-tsuchi at ΔE00 9.0. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (224°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
